claim_scores.rationale: Defines exactly two `dspy.Predict` fields, and `student.predictors()` enumerates predictor instances, so compile counts two predictor slots.
Both `self.first.lm` and `self.second.lm` are assigned the same `DummyLM` instance, isolating predictor-count vs model-count behavior.
Sets `multitask=False`, which makes `data_pred_ind = pred_ind` and thus creates distinct training keys per predictor instead of merging by LM.
Calls `optimizer.compile(student, trainset=trainset)` with `num_threads=1`; with two predictor-specific jobs, the `len(key_to_data) > num_threads` check raises `ValueError`.
The `ValueError` is the expected path, and the code prints the message and asserts it mentions `num_threads` and `fine-tuning jobs`.
